Develop, modify, and test embedded software under the guidance of experienced engineers.
Perform laboratory testing using standard electronic test equipment, such as power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes, and function generators.
Support product troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action activities.
Create and maintain engineering drawings, specifications, test reports, and other design documentation.

Manage multiple assignments with appropriate guidance while meeting established schedules and project requirements.
Communicate technical information clearly through verbal discussions, written reports, and presentations.
Follow all company safety policies and procedures.
Perform other duties as assigned.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
Foundational knowledge of analog and digital circuit design.
Basic understanding of embedded electronics, microprocessors, and electronic hardware development.
Familiarity with schematic capture, circuit simulation, or PCB design tools such as Altium Designer, OrCAD, or SPICE is preferred.
